turns.text: Good morning, Daniel! How is your Wednesday starting out in chilly Minneapolis?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Morning! It's definitely freezing today. But I'm starting the day on a bright note. I actually used one of the new shallow ceramic dishes Leah made in her pottery class. I filled it with a thick, blended berry and banana puree, then topped it with some chia seeds and grain granola, and ate it with a spoon. It felt nice using her handiwork.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a beautiful way to show appreciation for her pottery! How is she enjoying the class overall?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She absolutely loves it. She's getting really good at shaping clay. Anyway, I have a big day ahead at the design firm. I'm actually wearing a structured, navy tailored jacket and a pair of sharp, pressed formal trousers today because I have to lead a presentation for our biggest client.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: You must look incredibly sharp! A tailored jacket and formal trousers definitely project confidence. I'm sure you'll do an amazing job leading the presentation. How has your wrist been holding up with all the preparation?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's completely fine, thanks. Since the cast came off and it healed up, I barely even think about it. I can gesture during my presentation today without any stiffness at all.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That is wonderful news. It's great to have full mobility back, especially for your hobbies. Have you managed to get back into photography or cycling lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I haven't been on the bike as much with the colder weather, but I did take my camera out over the weekend to get some shots of the late autumn frost around the lakes. The light was perfect.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Minneapolis must look gorgeous with the frost. It sounds like you captured some beautiful scenes. Is Leah keeping busy with her own projects this week too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, she's got a lot on her plate with work, but she still makes time for her clay molding on the weekends. We're both just keeping our heads down and getting through the busy season.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It's a busy time of year for sure. Have you heard from your brother Kwame recently? How is he adjusting to life in Atlanta?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, I caught up with him on the phone yesterday. He says he's finally feeling settled in his new place and loves the warmer weather down there. Anyway, I need to head out the door now to get ready for this client meeting. Talk to you later!
